name: ch29_rainfall_maps-webmap
caption: Interactive: pan, zoom, switch layers and basemaps, change the overlay opacity.

name: ch29-map-sequential
caption: Sequential: one hue from light to dark, because the question has one direction (more rain). The stretch runs from 1,000 to 4,500 mm; values outside it are drawn at the ends.

name: ch29-map-diverging
caption: Diverging: brown for drier, teal for wetter, near-white for normal. The colour scale is symmetric around zero, so equal colours mean equal departures in both directions.

name: ch29-map-categorical
caption: Categorical: four seasons, four unrelated hues from the Okabe-Ito set, which stays distinct for the common forms of colour blindness.
